description: The iconography scope of Dense data: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: iconography.roles
answers.why: Icons mark row actions and status.

answers.question: iconography.count
answers.why: One size, matched to the small text.

answers.question: iconography.definition
answers.why: Outline icons at a 1.5px stroke stay light next to dense text.

answers.question: iconography.values
answers.why: Icons match the label so they do not outweigh it.

answers.question: iconography.lands
answers.why: Icons work hardest in toolbars and row actions.

usage.why: Experts learn icons; the tooltip covers the first uses.
Rows repeat dozens of times; a quiet icon keeps the table readable.

usage.not: An icon larger than its label
usage.why: Icons match the small text, so a toolbar reads as one line. The light stroke keeps rows quiet.

open-ds.why: 16px icons match the small text, so an icon and its label in a toolbar read as one line.

stroke-width.$description: The line weight of every icon, on Lucide's 24px grid.

open-ds.why: A 1.5px stroke width on Lucide's 24px grid keeps outline icons light, so they never outweigh the dense text beside them.

size.icon.headline: Small icons.
size.icon.line: Icons match the small text in rows and toolbars.
